title: Card
description: Fiori card with CardHeader (title, subtitle, status text, avatar, action, interactive) and CardContent.

usage.summary: Preview focused business content and offer access to its underlying page or task.
useWhen: Give users a focused preview of the content or KPI most relevant to a business task.
Let users perform a simple action or navigate to the underlying content from the preview.
Compose CardHeader and CardContent; make the header interactive when it opens a meaningful related destination.

avoidWhen.when: Lead a chart card with a primary KPI, trend and supporting indicators.
Group information inside a page and let users collapse it rather than preview an independent destination.
Introduce a product home page with a greeting, context and task shortcuts.
